changelog: - **Trial → paid conversion on `/admin/analytics`, and an owner handover is one journey** (#2556). The funnel route (`/api/admin/analytics/funnel`) now folds every transfer chain (`previousRelationId`, written by `src/lib/mentorTransfer.ts`) into ONE journey before any KPI is computed — pure `relationChains()` + `mergeChainJourney()` in `src/lib/funnelKpi.ts`: the start is the root's, the changes the union of every link's. Before, a handover opened a successor on the same stage and the funnel read it as a second entry and a second win in the transfer month, while the closed predecessor never churned. The route loads the rest of each chain the window touched (predecessors and successors, transitively), so a windowed read folds whole chains too (the windowed query also admits a record whose `trialStartedAt` falls in the window). Not folded yet: the per-stage counts of `/api/admin/analytics` (the stage chart), which still read one row per relation. New `trialConversion` block on the same response: trial → paid cohorted by the month the trial STARTED (`trialStartedAt`, else the first arrival at the trial stage; skipping the stage is not a trial), computed by the existing `conversionByEntryMonth()` with a new `enteredAt` anchor option rather than a second engine, plus a split by referral source. The trial stage is resolved from the tenant's own stage rows (`TRIAL_ACTIVE_STAGE_KEY`), paid is `outcomeStageKeysFrom().finished[0]`; a tenant with no trial stage gets `null` and no card. A month is **mature** only once it has closed and every trial in it has ended (`trialEndsAt`, else start + the tenant's `trialLengthDays`); an immature month's `rate` is `null` and renders "—". The source split reads mature months only and stays behind `premiumAnalytics` (the #2421 decision) — `bySource: null` when locked. New `TrialConversionCard`, a row in the Excel export (`Trial to paid`, `Trial by source`) and in the full print report. Unit tests in `npm run test:funnel-cohorts` (two-link chain = one win and one journey; maturity; source split; renamed stages).

en: The analytics page has a new Trial → paid card for sales pipelines with a trial stage: of the trials that started in a month, how many became paying customers — and, on the premium tier, the same rate by lead source.

A month shows a dash until every trial started in it has ended, because a trial that is still running has not had its chance to convert yet. Handing an account over to a new owner now counts as one customer, not two, in the funnel conversion, cohort, retention and trial reports.
tr: Analitik sayfasına deneme aşaması olan satış pipeline'ları için yeni bir Deneme → ücretli kartı eklendi: bir ayda başlayan denemelerin kaçı ücretli müşteriye döndü — premium pakette aynı oran müşteri adayı kaynağına göre de.

Bir ayda başlayan denemelerin hepsi bitene kadar o ay tire gösterir, çünkü süren bir deneme henüz dönüşme fırsatı bulmadı. Bir hesabın yeni bir sorumluya devri artık funnel dönüşümü, kohort, elde tutma ve deneme raporlarında iki değil tek müşteri sayılıyor.
de: Die Analyse-Seite hat eine neue Karte Testphase → zahlend für Vertriebspipelines mit einer Testphase: Wie viele der in einem Monat begonnenen Testphasen wurden zu zahlenden Kunden — und im Premium-Paket dieselbe Quote nach Lead-Quelle.

Ein Monat zeigt einen Strich, bis jede darin begonnene Testphase geendet hat, denn eine laufende Testphase hatte noch keine Gelegenheit zu konvertieren. Die Übergabe eines Accounts an einen neuen Verantwortlichen zählt in den Berichten zu Funnel-Konversion, Kohorten, Bindung und Testphasen jetzt als ein Kunde, nicht als zwei.
